summary: Two comparison columns (Monolith gray #4b5468, Microservices indigo #4338ca) plus a left row-label gutter; exactly 4 comparison rows (Deployment, Scaling, Team Structure, Fault Isolation), no extras. Verdict banner at the bottom reads 'Recommended: Microservices for teams over 20 engineers' with the correct threshold. Computed contrast (WCAG): white on #4338ca = 7.9:1, white on #4b5468 = 7.6:1, body text #2c3348 on white = 12.5:1 — all pass AA and AAA for the sizes used. Clearance between the last card row (bottom ~540px) and the banner top (584px) is ~44px, no overlap or crowding. Text sizes: title 44px, column headers 24px, row labels 20px, cell body 20px, banner 24px — all at or above the 20px presentation floor. Report confirms scrollW/scrollH 1280x720 with no overflow; console log is empty; t0/t2/t5 are byte-identical, correct for a static slide. Banner SVG (lucide users) renders cleanly with no clipped strokes or stray artifacts. No unrequested elements. Held back from 100 only because the layout uses a three-track grid (label gutter + two columns) rather than a literal two-column split — a standard and arguably better comparison-table idiom, not counted as a defect.
